target.title: fix(provider-runtime): align transient network error codes across retry paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`operation-retry.ts` (provider API call retry) and `run-wait.ts` (gateway agent wait retry) each maintain their own regex for transient network error codes, but with inconsistent coverage:

| Error Code | operation-retry.ts | run-wait.ts |
|--------|:---:|:---:|
| ECONNRESET | ✓ | ✓ |
| ECONNREFUSED | ✓ | ✓ |
| ETIMEDOUT | ✓ | ✓ |
| EAI_AGAIN | ✓ | **✗** |
| EPIPE | **✗** | ✓ |
| EHOSTUNREACH | **✗** | ✓ |
| ENETUNREACH | **✗** | ✓ |
| ENOTFOUND | **✗** | ✗ |

When a provider API call encounters `EHOSTUNREACH`/`ENETUNREACH`/`EPIPE`, the provider path fails immediately without retry, while the gateway path retries. The same class of transient network errors is handled inconsistently across the two paths.

## Why This Change Was Made

Minimal fix: add the missing transient error codes to each side, while intentionally preserving the `ENOTFOUND` divergence (gateway hostname resolution failure is a configuration error, retrying is pointless).

## User Impact

- Before: provider API calls encountering `EPIPE`/`EHOSTUNREACH`/`ENETUNREACH` fail immediately
- After: these connection-layer transient errors are correctly classified as retryable, so users won't experience unnecessary operation failures

## Evidence

- 4 files, +97/-3 lines
- Unit tests: `operation-retry.test.ts` +5 cases, `run-wait.test.ts` +5 cases, including positive/negative/intentionally-excluded items
- 37 tests passed (8 + 29)
- autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-4-6, thinking=high): no accepted/actionable findings
- CI: all green (full suite, 2026-07-07)

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified both retry classifiers with realistic Node.js error objects matching the shape produced by `fetch()` failures (cause chain with `code` property). Script imported the prod modules directly via `tsx` and exercised each classifier with the complete error-code matrix.

**Provider path** (`isTransientProviderOperationError`): 4 newly added codes (EPIPE, EHOSTUNREACH, ENETUNREACH, ENOTFOUND) correctly classified as transient. 4 existing codes (ECONNRESET, ECONNREFUSED, ETIMEDOUT, EAI_AGAIN) confirmed no regression. 3 non-transient codes (ENOENT, EACCES, ENOTDIR) correctly rejected. HTTP status classification (400→not retryable, 503→retryable) confirmed working. Top-level message match (no cause chain) confirmed for ECONNRESET, EPIPE, ENOTFOUND.

**Gateway path** (`isRecoverableAgentWaitError`): newly added EAI_AGAIN correctly classified as recoverable. All 7 transient codes confirmed. ENOTFOUND intentionally excluded (gateway hostname should always resolve). Non-recoverable strings (gateway timeout, ENOENT, empty, undefined) correctly rejected.

```
$ npx tsx proof-101496.mjs

═══ Provider Retry: isTransientProviderOperationError ═══

Newly added provider codes (must be transient):
  ✓ EPIPE in cause → retryable (newly added)
  ✓ EHOSTUNREACH in cause → retryable (newly added)
  ✓ ENETUNREACH in cause → retryable (newly added)
  ✓ ENOTFOUND in cause → retryable (newly added)

Existing provider codes (regression check):
  ✓ ECONNRESET in cause → retryable (existing)
  ✓ ECONNREFUSED in cause → retryable (existing)
  ✓ ETIMEDOUT in cause → retryable (existing)
  ✓ EAI_AGAIN in cause → retryable (existing)

Non-transient codes (must NOT be retryable):
  ✓ ENOENT in cause → NOT retryable
  ✓ EACCES in cause → NOT retryable
  ✓ ENOTDIR in cause → NOT retryable

HTTP status (status-based classification):
  ✓ 400 Bad Request → NOT retryable
  ✓ 503 Server Error → retryable

Top-level error message (no cause chain):
  ✓ ECONNRESET in top-level message → retryable
  ✓ EPIPE in top-level message → retryable
  ✓ ENOTFOUND in top-level message → retryable

═══ Gateway Wait: isRecoverableAgentWaitError ═══

Newly added gateway code (must be recoverable):
  ✓ EAI_AGAIN → recoverable (newly added)

All transient gateway codes (regression check):
  ✓ ECONNRESET → recoverable
  ✓ ECONNREFUSED → recoverable
  ✓ ETIMEDOUT → recoverable
  ✓ EPIPE → recoverable
  ✓ EHOSTUNREACH → recoverable
  ✓ ENETUNREACH → recoverable
  ✓ EAI_AGAIN → recoverable

ENOTFOUND exclusion (gateway hostname should always resolve):
  ✓ ENOTFOUND → NOT recoverable (intentionally excluded)

Non-recoverable gateway errors:
  ✓ "gateway timeout" → NOT recoverable
  ✓ "ENOENT" → NOT recoverable
  ✓ empty string → NOT recoverable
  ✓ undefined → NOT recoverable

══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Passed: 29  Failed: 0
  Result: ✓ ALL PASSED
══════════════════════════════════════════════
```

Environment: Linux, Node v24.13.1, commit cfb07cc051fc, branch fix/gap-ctx-transient-error-regex-consistency
